dots: Single pixel or point marks used to simulate tone.
checkerboard: Alternating pattern of dark and light pixels creating a mesh-like texture.
worms: Elongated clusters or streaks of pixels that resemble crawling worms.
diagonal_crawl: Patterns of pixels that move diagonally across the image, often in error diffusion algorithms.
cluster_clouds: Groups of pixels forming cloud-like textures in clustered dithering.
